name: Lee's Orchard
tagline: Lee's Orchards, 65 Orchard Ln, Washington, VA 22747, US
description: In Washington, VA, Lee's Orchard raises Apples and Honey on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
